senses.gloss: m. (גרד) scraper, scratcher, gurd’li, a nickname for an inferior white wine, adopted as a play on חרדלי a dark red wine (mustard-colored).
units: Gen. R. s. 98 יין חרדלי … יין ג׳ וכ׳ if thou drankest ḥard’li, thou drankest wine; if gurd’li, thou drankest bad wine.
<cite ref="Shabbat 62b:23">Sabb. 62ᵇ</cite> sq. (an obscene disguise for a fair-complected woman).
